title: Induction of Non-Monotonic Logic Programs to Explain Boosted Tree Models Using LIME
reasoning: The paper focuses on Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) and Explainable AI (XAI) for boosting tree models like XGBoost. It uses standard machine learning datasets (UCI) for performance evaluation but does not contain any components related to benchmarking or evaluating religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
